blocks.x: Yield +2.8 points, recalls scoped in minutes — quality and traceability program
A food processor (dairy) — Agriculture & Food Systems engagement delivered by a 13-person team over 11 months, EU scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

Vision grading at intake standardized quality decisions; the yield analytics platform decomposed losses by line and lot; cold-chain telemetry made safety evidence continuous; and the lot-traceability network (Ledger) answers recall queries in minutes with anchored custody events.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.
